New from the Brain Garden archive: The Moving Target

When you learned to code in the 1990s, that skill lasted thirty years. The same investment made a decade later bought you ten. Made five years ago, you might already be rebuilding. The half life is compressing. That's not a metaphor. It's a pattern with a direction. There are three waves of people building with AI right now. Most companies are hiring from...

Read it here: https://davidmieloch.com/blog/the-moving-target?utm_source=facebook-page&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=factory_content_pipeline&utm_content=the-moving-target
